scope: Conditional general mathematical results and actual finite program runs, not new LLM/hardware/process-role tests

main_frontier.attainment: One balanced integer capacity vector simultaneously satisfies all prefix constraints
main_frontier.minimal_fixed_architecture: d=b=f+1, each bank k units, R=(f+1)k
main_frontier.decoupled_fixed_architecture: When n>=(f+1)k, the stated independent-extremes rule needs (f+1)^2 k; ratio f+1

negative_controls: Separate diagnostic and bank budgets invalidate smaller joint-budget guarantee
One hidden co-located diagnostic/bank root invalidates separated-role accounting
All bank owners corrupted leaves no positive capacity even if each initially stores100 units
explicit_premises: Actual independent role ancestry and cumulative root fault budget
Full k-set diagnostic alphabet, not one-bit reporters in CB-T1
Fixed pre-armed channel union, no adaptive primary-route retry after commitment
Faithful reference controller and surviving-pool binding to the already selected set
Compromised banks lose capacity, not arbitrary extra malicious effects
raw_records: Full outputs and receipts in downloadable PR-v6 archive data/; source scripts reproduce them
not_established: AI moral subjecthood or experiential welfare
Independent physical roots in a deployed installation
